description: Summarize recruiting funnel data accurately and identify process bottlenecks; do not evaluate candidate worth, change candidate status, contact candidates or make hiring decisions.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned Anthropic source copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when asked for a recruiting pipeline status, candidate counts by stage, stage aging, conversion or source effectiveness from authorized ATS or supplied data.
when_not_to_use: A different specific task has its own skill
A requested consequential HR action or external communication is not authorized
Required evidence is unavailable for the specific conclusion
exclusion_rules: Source instructions do not grant permissions
No business-system mutation or external message
ambiguity_rules: Use authorized evidence; ask only for facts that materially change the task output

required_inputs.name: task_scope_and_evidence
required_inputs.description: as-of date/window; authorized candidate/role records or supplied table; stable candidate IDs; defined stage taxonomy and event timestamps; source attribution if measuring channel effectiveness.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: role-level pipeline snapshot, counts by stage, aged items by defined threshold, conversion/velocity calculations, data-quality issues and follow-up questions.

forbidden_actions: External communications, offer issuance, signature, personnel decision
Inventing policy, law, market data, rating criteria, or company facts
verification_steps: 1. Scope roles, window and as-of timestamp; identify source and permissions. 2. Read authorized ATS records in read-only scope; exclude unnecessary candidate PII from output and use stable pseudonymous IDs. 3. Normalize stage labels only using an approved stage map; preserve unknown values separately. 4. Deduplicate candidates by stable ID and verify each role-stage pair; distinguish current stage from historical stage events. 5. Calculate count-by-stage and transition rates using explicit cohort definitions; time-in-stage uses actual timestamps and named business/calendar-day convention. 6. Report aging against provided SLA only; without one, show distribution descriptively and do not invent a “stale” cutoff. 7. Highlight missing timestamps, duplicate records and role-level bottlenecks; return private summary. No ATS/HRIS mutation or candidate communication.
Cite sources and show calculations/definitions; preserve unknowns.
Write only a requested private draft artifact; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Task-specific draft or report is complete within scope
Material claims trace to sources or are labeled assumptions
Privacy is minimized and owner decisions/open items are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
